name: Chocos ~Maid-san no Gohoushi~
original_name: ちょこす～メイドさんのご奉仕～
source:
Main character is a director of drama club at formerly girls' school. He chooses main heroine for his next big work and starts her special training which very soon turns into cosplay sex play.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是原女子学校戏剧社的社长。他为他的下一部大作选择了主要女主角，并开始了她的特殊训练，很快就变成了角色扮演性爱游戏。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
